summary: Clean on the DES dimension. All three modules are thin, uniform @proxy/_call_lib_func wrappers exactly matching the documented 'Adding a New Binding' convention (CLAUDE.md); the cross-file repetition is the intended pattern, not duplication to collapse. __all__ lists match the defined wrappers, imports are all used, and the load_lib usage is consistently differentiated (conn binds _sqlite3_lib because proxy_if_available consumes it; stmt/exec call load_lib for side-effect only since they have no version-gated symbols). No dead code, no reinvented primitives, no over-complexity, no API-consistency or comment/code-drift issues found.
